nodes.label: NEOWISE Single Exposure Database
nodes.info: Contains ~200 billion rows of single-exposure photometry. Each row is an apparition with RA, DEC, MJD timestamp, W1 and W2 magnitudes. Data is unordered and noisy, requiring clustering to reconstruct light curves.

nodes.label: SQL Data Query
nodes.info: Retrieves subsets of apparitions matching sky coordinates or constraints. Output is unstructured and unlabeled observations.

nodes.label: DBSCAN Clustering
nodes.info: Density-based spatial clustering groups apparitions belonging to the same astronomical source using RA/DEC proximity. Filters noise and cosmic-ray artifacts.

nodes.label: Light Curve Assembly
nodes.info: Clusters are converted into ordered time series using MJD timestamps, forming raw light curves per source.

nodes.label: Data Cleaning
nodes.info: Removes outliers, spurious detections, and low-quality measurements. Improves signal reliability.

nodes.label: Normalization
nodes.info: Standardizes flux values, timestamps, and uncertainties to stable numeric ranges for neural network input.

nodes.label: Tensor Construction
nodes.info: Builds input tensors of shape (B, 3, N) containing flux, uncertainty, and timestamp channels.

nodes.label: Synthetic Light Curve Generator
nodes.info: Simulates unlimited labeled light curves for four classes: Null, Transient, Pulsating, Transit. Uses parametric models and noise injection.

nodes.label: Training Dataset
nodes.info: Combination of synthetic curves and real validated infrared variables used to train VARnet.

nodes.label: Initial Convolution Layers
nodes.info: Three 1D CNN layers extract low-level temporal patterns from input tensors.

nodes.label: Wavelet Decomposition
nodes.info: Discrete Wavelet Transform (biorthogonal 2.2) splits signal into approximation and detail components to suppress noise and isolate transient impulses.

nodes.label: Feature Concatenation
nodes.info: Original signal is concatenated with wavelet approximation and detail channels.

nodes.label: Mid Convolution Layers
nodes.info: Three CNN layers compress features and prepare frequency-sensitive representations.

nodes.label: Finite Embedding Fourier Transform
nodes.info: Custom DFT projection into fixed-size vector (700 samples). Learnable frequency sampling extracts periodic signatures efficiently.

nodes.label: Post Fourier CNN Layers
nodes.info: Three convolution layers analyze local frequency neighborhoods.

nodes.label: Fully Connected Layers
nodes.info: Three dense layers map extracted features to class logits.

nodes.label: Predicted Class
nodes.info: Final classification: Null, Transient, Pulsating, Transit.

nodes.label: Human Inspection
nodes.info: Flagged anomalies are cross-validated using SIMBAD, WISEView, and phase-folding.

links.info: Unstructured points sent for spatial grouping
